subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Lloyd's Coffee House
description: A short lesson to help you apply Lloyd's Coffee House.

hook.text: In 1688, Edward Lloyd opened a coffee house in London. It became the birthplace of modern insurance.

buildup.text: Merchants, shipowners, and underwriters gathered there to negotiate coverage for sea voyages.

discovery.text: Underwriters wrote their names under the risks they covered — that's where 'underwriting' comes from.

twist.text: A coffee house became the center of global risk transfer. Lloyd's still operates over 330 years later.

climax.text: The world's most famous insurance market started with coffee, gossip, and handshake deals.

punchline.text: Coffee, conversation, and risk. Lloyd's changed it all.

quiz.question: What does the term 'underwriting' originally refer to?
options: Writing one's name under the risk being covered
Writing loan terms under a contract
